basic_info.description: Experience elevated penthouse living at Residence 805, extensively remodeled 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom residence in the heart of South Beach/Rincon Hill. Spanning almost 1600 sq.ft., this home is designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living, featuring an expansive ~747 sq. ft. private terrace with breathtaking downtown views. The open-concept living area offers rare flexibility, with soaring ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows enhancing the sense of space and light. Both bedrooms include two walk-in closets and spa-like en-suite bathrooms. Residents enjoy premium amenities, including a fitness center, a rooftop deck with BBQ and lounge seating, and secure garage parking. This penthouse also comes with two deeded parking spaces and a large storage unit. Located in a boutique-style building near the Embarcadero waterfront and Financial District, this home offers the perfect blend of luxury, privacy, and urban convenience.
